During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Soaring Dactillions]] conducted a '''raid''' on the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]],<ref name="Zal" /> a key [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction facility in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].<ref name="AoRCB">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> The result was that the Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] took a high amount of casualties, which resulted in the unit being rendered under-strength and rotated to the [[Cardooine/Legends|Cardooine]] [[Rebel base (Cardooine)|base]]. A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later, the squadron [[Assault on Cardooine|defended]] their base using [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|prototype starfighters]].<ref name="Zal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid was first mentioned in Zal Artha's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] boxed set [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beginner Game]].<ref name="Zal" />
